findingDetails.title: Nine fan-out playbook scenarios name a test path that does not exist, so their exact command sequence cannot produce the result they demand
findingDetails.evidence: The scenarios run cd .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime && npx vitest run ../../runtime//tests/unit/<file>; from that directory ../../runtime resolves to .skilled/skills/runtime which does not exist, while the named tests live at .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/tests/unit/. Nine affected scenarios enumerated; two control scenarios use the correct deep-loop base; fanout-merge/pool/run/salvage test files exist on disk. The lines arrived with commit e14d5b196b7 and are present in the v4.0.0.3 blob, so the release ships them.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replace the nine commands with the correct base (cd .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime && npx vitest run tests/unit/<file>), matching the control scenarios.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Enumerated every offending occurrence, resolved the relative path from the stated working directory, confirmed .skilled/skills/runtime is absent, confirmed the named tests exist at the deep-loop path, and read two correct-form controls.
